answer.text: Spray the chain with the recommended chain cleaning solvent while rotating the rear wheel, and cover the whole chain.
If needed, use a suitable brush to remove hard deposits from the chain.
Wait a few minutes, then clean the chain thoroughly to remove dirt and grime.
Rotate the rear wheel slowly while applying the recommended chain lubricant to the chain links.
After a few minutes, wipe off the excess lubricant with a clean cloth.
Clean and lubricate the chain every 500 km (or earlier as required), and after riding in wet, dusty or muddy conditions.
